recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Cicadas, Passover, and Spiritual Sovereignty", "body": "Joshua opened with the cicada, describing its long underground life, prime number emergence cycles and high mercury content, and linking it to Hermes and to Plato's tale of singers who never needed to eat. He tied the insects' spring song to Passover, first fruits and the lamb. Joshua argued that the lamb's blood was a ransom from spiritual captivity and that real sovereignty was spiritual rather than financial. He also said the ram's head stood for the temple, that the aim was activating the pineal gland, and that the feast days were meant to keep the body a clean vessel. These were his own interpretations."}, {"title": "Fiction, World Mind, and Seeded Narratives", "body": "Chance floated the idea that competing stories of a coming pole flip might have been seeded across society to alchemically transmute the world mind and draw fiction into reality. Gordy, calling in, tied this to the invisible college notion of symbology as an incorruptible language, and compared superhero comics to a new set of gods. Joshua added that the Fabian Society, which he said drew many fiction authors, may have softened minds for new ideas, and compared the process to bread and circuses. A stained glass image of two smiths striking a molten world was also described."}, {"title": "Callers, Stones, Dowsing, and the World Turtle", "body": "Callers joined the Aries evening. One caller joked that a sheep was a domesticated ram, so the caller was no sheeple but a rambler. Gordy showed magnetic Moki marbles he said he found in the desert by asking the stones to show themselves and then dropping magnets where his dowsing sense pointed. A listener's story about a river turtle whose shell patterns gave rise to the I Ching was read aloud, and participants linked the shell's thirteen and twenty eight plates to lunar months and to a world resting on a turtle's back."}, {"title": "Taxes, Tithes, and Render Unto Caesar", "body": "Tax day sparked a long talk about money and authority. One caller argued that taking tax straight from a paycheck put government ahead of God, so that tithing from take home pay meant giving to God second. Several speakers offered competing readings of render unto Caesar, including that it meant handing back the legal persona, or the coin itself. One participant showed a 1928 silver certificate and said it was not a federal reserve note and not debt, and a caller recommended a documentary arguing that the Wizard of Oz was an allegory of the silver movement."}, {"title": "Rams, Hiram Abiff, and the Lion and Lamb", "body": "Reading from a Gnostic Warrior page on the ram, Joshua argued that the ram carried divine thought while the bull carried divine speech. He retold the Masonic story of Hiram Abiff, saying the lost word meant only a skeleton could be raised, which one of the hosts then tied to the idea of legal personhood. Joshua also said the name Aries echoed the word for lion, and that the lion and lamb pairing came from a muddled memory of Isaiah, where it was a wolf and a lamb. Another speaker connected wolfram, a name for tungsten, to a swapped wolf and lamb."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Joshua Donohew is a highly knowledgeable Servant of Source and a fellow brother born under the sign of Aries. On this Vibe Rant, we'll get to know Joshua a bit better while benefiting from his wealth of symbolic and biblical insights on the magical realm of creation we all share.
